scope: Native New Tab/+ launcher, authored main host filtering and profile catalog/icons, terminal creation and explicit process-close confirmation, and keyboard/focus ownership. No daemon, protocol, app or Android product changes.

goal.objective: 我们迁移到GPUI吧 安卓仍然保持不变

checks.testNote: Eight lifecycle tests run on Linux, macOS and Windows for the config-feed source. Later changes only affect launcher host filtering/presentation and UI choice/keyboard wiring; the tested lifecycle module, generated profile data and 27-case oracle remain byte-identical. No redundant core suite rerun. All three final applications rebuild.
checks.finalArtifactDelta: After GUI checks, the generated writer removes one redundant terminal LF from 39 catalog SVG assets. Final Rust sources, vector element bytes and tested model/data/oracle are unchanged. All three final application binaries rebuild; svg-eof-normalization.json checks each final SVG plus LF against its GUI input SHA256. UI frames remain from the pre-normalization binary.

linuxGUI.fixture: Real private daemon, a delayed WebSocket proxy, raw Node PTYs labelled Pi/Grok, and a plain shell. No actual Pi/Grok or model invocation.
linuxGUI.display: Private Xvfb :99, software rendering; no hardware performance claim
linuxGUI.settings: dark/en, UI/content/code 14/15/12, shared GTK Noto Sans10
linuxGUI.evidence: Actual XTest pointer/keyboard events, persisted pane layouts, real RPC identities and raw PTY input; OCR plus raw screenshots.
linuxGUI.phases: Workspace/split/delayed-response checks were first run before the config-feed and final presentation refinements. Close-to-editor keyboard regression reproduced red, then passed after pane-owned focus and editor focus registration fixes. The final profile launch/cancel/close, launcher-choice isolation, Browser shortcut, catalog hot-reload and pixel frames use the recorded final or immediately preceding UI-only binaries. The final binary repeats Browser entry/close and live empty/restore catalog checks. Raw phase helpers are historical records, not a single cold-start test suite.
linuxGUI.processDialog: Linux GTK system dialog; Cancel/Escape sends no kill, confirm names the exact terminal ID. macOS/Windows compile only; their native dialog GUI presentation is not accepted.

visual.reference: Real Electron with unchanged workspace-header Expo export, same three retained Node terminal IDs and alpha.rs file, and a New Tab in the main pane. Reference uses actual file selection and tab-drag UI.
visual.notes: Main host support now derives from the authored panel manifest, so Files/Changes stay in Explorer. New Tab dimensions and profile vectors derive from authored sources. Raw launcher crop differences decrease from 78881 to 24156 pixels; raw menu crop from 25874 to 19696. Agent/edit-profile actions are still disabled, and keyboard focus, tab/menu half-pixel positions, text rasterization and surrounding sidebar/header remain different.

limits: Main Agent drafts and host terminal-profile editing remain unimplemented; embedded Agent UI keeps lower priority.
Explorer launcher/panel hosting, plugin panels, full tab menus/reordering/status, custom keyboard bindings, long-catalog focus reveal/accessibility and file-buffer restoration remain pending.

Linux system close confirmation currently admits X11 only. Wayland reports unavailable without stopping a process. macOS/Windows native prompt title/default-button/layout/keyboard GUI parity remain pending.
Full IME/Unicode/terminal completeness, same-workload hardware input/scroll CPU/RSS measurements, all three OS GUI acceptance, packaging/release and installed-client deployment remain pending.

reproduction.instructions: Set PASEO_NATIVE_QA to a private output directory and run the fixture with node --import tsx from the repository. Copy input.py/launch.py phase helpers into that directory; start an isolated :99 Xvfb and seed dark/en plus GTK Noto Sans10. Initial workspace has one raw Node PTY; prime a second via the Pi-labelled profile before the first historical phase. The phase helpers assume specific prior pane/tab state and use the recorded 1280x800 geometry. Run the relevant phase only after reproducing its documented setup. Legacy phase scripts include the original red paths/old coordinates; final-presentation, launcher-choice and Browser-entry helpers record later fixes. Do not run against production or real agents. Reference needs the cached/exported app bundle, a matched live fixture and native-layout-visual.json; it blocks all 6767 network requests. Actual cleanup explicitly kills only fixture terminal IDs before stopping its owning daemon/display.
